dashboard_title: WABA Group - Mobile Money & Transferts Transfrontaliers (Dashboard 3)
description: Suivi opérationnel des paiements digitaux, saturation des couloirs régionaux UEMOA et fiabilité télécom

charts.slice_name: Flux de Paiements Mobile Money par Pays et par Heure (Heatmap)
charts.query: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM timestamp) AS hour_of_day, country_code, SUM(amount_eur) AS sum__volume_eur FROM iceberg.silver.mobile_money_payments GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM timestamp), country_code

charts.slice_name: Top 5 des Corridors Transfrontaliers UEMOA (CI->SN, CI->ML...)
charts.query: SELECT corridor, SUM(total_volume_eur) AS sum__total_volume_eur, SUM(transfer_count) AS total_transfers FROM iceberg.gold.cross_border_transfers GROUP BY corridor ORDER BY sum__total_volume_eur DESC LIMIT 5

charts.slice_name: Taux d'Échec des Transactions par Opérateur et Pays
charts.query: SELECT operator, country_code, ROUND(AVG(failure_rate) * 100, 2) AS avg__failure_rate_pct FROM iceberg.gold.mobile_money_daily_flow GROUP BY operator, country_code ORDER BY avg__failure_rate_pct DESC
